author: Outror@
title: Very good but missing some few features
content:
Encryption is superb and with two new features the interface would be up to it: 
 1- A PIN (apart from the session pw) to lock the app, so the encryption password (session pw) does not need to be cached. 
2- Auto erase of the log/history at the bottom of the app, showing the name of the last opened file, after the user resets the session pw.
